note: The command set this box's Home advertises through authenticated discovery. The View may reference these ids; referencing one grants nothing. The Home owns authorization, base/freshness checks, idempotency, and the receipt. A command absent from discovery for the current session renders as an inert 'Unavailable in this session' control.

commands.label: Stop engine
commands.effect: Stops the engine. In-flight requests fail; none are queued across the boundary.

commands.label: Restart engine
commands.effect: Stops and starts the unit in one admitted action.

commands.label: Apply requested model
commands.effect: Loads desired.model, unloading the current one first. Long-running; status becomes starting.
commands.refuses_when: desired.model is already loaded, or is not present in models

commands.label: Unload model
commands.effect: Frees VRAM and sets desired.model to null.

commands.label: Update engine
commands.effect: Starts tokenwright-update.service, which installs the pinned version and restarts the engine. The pin is fixed by the package and cannot be passed in.
commands.refuses_when: the installed version already matches the pin

commands.label: Re-check now
commands.effect: Starts tokenwright-posture-scan.service, which re-runs every check and writes the result the supervisor projects.

commands.label: Enable direct access
commands.effect: Sets desired.direct_access and brings up tokenwright-wg.service. Survives reboot. GaugeDesk does not use this path.

commands.label: Disable direct access
commands.effect: Clears desired.direct_access and takes tokenwright-wg.service down. Tools using it lose access; the relay path is unaffected.

commands.label: Fetch declared models
commands.effect: Downloads every id in desired.models the box does not hold, verifying each against its recorded digest. Long-running.
commands.refuses_when: every declared model is already present, or free disk would not hold what is missing

commands.label: Free orphaned models
commands.effect: Deletes every model dropped from desired.models. Nothing else is touched, and no argument selects what goes.

commands.label: I have saved it
commands.effect: Clears the revealed secret. The value is not recoverable afterwards by any means.

commands.label: Unpair this box
commands.effect: Forgets the Home this box serves, revokes every key including the Home's own, and returns the box to its unpaired state. A fresh claim code is minted and printed on the box's console only; no route returns it, so whoever claims the box next has to be standing next to it.
commands.refuses_when: nothing — an unpaired box does not answer the management surface at all, so this cannot be issued a second time
